apps.name: Teeny Tiny Web
apps.subtitle: Small but Mighty Dev Resources.
apps.description: A little bit of everything, right in the middle web tools, files, helpers etc...
apps.longDescription: Teeny Tiny Web is a compact hub built around the idea that the best developer resources don’t need to be big or complicated to be useful. With the motto “Small but Mighty Dev Resources,” the platform brings together a little bit of everything - practical web tools, helpful utilities, handy files, and simple developer helpers - all in one place. Designed to sit right in the middle of everyday workflows, Teeny Tiny Web focuses on speed, simplicity, and usefulness, giving developers quick access to the small resources that make a big difference in daily development.
features: Tools: A growing collection of free online developer tools
Projects: Real-world mini projects demonstrating essential web development concepts
Docs: Concise guides and tutorials covering development best practices
Roadmaps: Step-by-step learning paths for various developer roles
Dummy Data Generator: Generate realistic mock data for testing APIs and front-end applications
Freebies: A collection of downloadable resources such as PDFs, templates, and more.

apps.name: Substrack
apps.subtitle: A simple mobile subscription tracking app.
apps.description: Track your subscriptions, see upcoming renewals, review monthly spending, enable billing reminders, and keep everything organized locally on your device.
apps.longDescription: Substrack helps you keep track of recurring subscriptions in one simple, organized place. You can add subscriptions, set prices and billing dates, see what renews next, and understand how much you spend each month and year. The app is designed to make recurring payments easier to follow without requiring an account, ads, analytics tracking, or a complicated setup. Substrack stores your subscription data locally on your device and uses exchange rates to help display totals in your selected currency, continuing with default values when exchange rates are unavailable.

Keep subscription data stored locally on your device

apps.name: Donit
apps.subtitle: A daily task app that turns your day into a winning streak.
apps.description: Add your tasks for today, check them off before the day ends, and win the day. Consecutive wins build a streak. One question, every day.
apps.longDescription: Donit keeps it simple: every day, you write down what you're going to do and check it off before midnight. Complete everything and you win the day. Win enough days in a row and you build a streak. Every win adds to it, and every miss resets it, unless you have a Streak Shield. The Streak Shield is your safety net. Every new user starts with one free. When life gets in the way, it absorbs the loss and keeps your streak alive. Additional shields are available as a one-time purchase, with no subscription, ever. Donit requires no account, no login, and no internet connection. Everything stays on your device. Reach 10, 30, 60, 90, or 120 days and Donit marks the moment with a shareable milestone card.
features: Add tasks for today and check them off before the day ends
Win the day when all tasks are completed
Build a streak with consecutive daily wins
Use a Streak Shield to protect your streak when you miss a day
Every new user starts with one free Streak Shield
Purchase additional shields as a one-time in-app purchase
Track your streak history and activity grid
View current and longest streak stats
Unlock milestones at 10, 30, 60, 90, and 120 days
Share milestone cards at every 30-day mark
Available in English, Turkish, German, and Spanish
No account, no login, no internet connection required
All data stored locally on your device

apps.name: Ventus
apps.subtitle: Operations platform for lesson-based sport schools and course providers.
apps.description: Ventus is an operations management system that lets lesson-based sport schools and course providers run their lessons, students, instructors, packages, and calendar from a single platform.
apps.longDescription: Ventus was built to help lesson-based businesses manage their entire daily operational workload from one central place. Students check in to lessons by scanning a QR code, keeping attendance automatic and error-free. Instructors can track their own lessons, student attendance rates, and earnings in real time, while the school manager views all of this data from a single dashboard of overall statistics. Student, instructor, package, and revenue tracking in lesson-based businesses is usually split across disconnected tools (notebooks, spreadsheets, separate apps), which increases the margin for error and makes instructor payouts and package usage harder to calculate correctly. Ventus unifies these processes into a single platform for instant, accurate visibility. It is actively used by Kite Izmir, and the same infrastructure was designed to be adaptable to other similarly structured sport schools and course providers.
features: Lesson and calendar management
QR code check-in for lesson attendance
Student attendance rate tracking
Instructor payout/earnings calculation
Manager dashboard with overall statistics
Monthly reporting

apps.name: Valora
apps.subtitle: A private listing and portfolio platform for real estate investment advisors.
apps.description: Valora is a real estate investment tracking and analysis platform where advisors can present private listings to their investors, who can monitor their portfolios and evaluate new opportunities.
apps.longDescription: Unlike public listing sites, Valora lets an advisor share their own private, closed listing pool with specific investors. Investors can track their entire portfolio from one place and get notified about opportunities highlighted by their advisor. Real estate investors typically track their portfolios and opportunities across scattered channels - email, phone calls, different listing sites - while advisors don't want to expose their private listings publicly. Valora creates a private, centralized tracking and presentation layer between advisor and investor.
features: Private, closed listing sharing for advisors
Investor portfolio tracking
Opportunity notifications
Detailed investment analysis dashboard

apps.name: Anda
apps.subtitle: A single platform for schools to manage the entire yearbook process.
apps.description: Anda is a web application that manages the school yearbook process end-to-end, giving students, teachers, and printing companies access to the same data from one place.
apps.longDescription: Anda was designed so students can permanently view their digital yearbooks, teachers can contribute content, and the printing company handling physical production can access all the data it needs from a single point. Instead of scattered file exchanges throughout the process, a single centralized data source is used. Preparing a yearbook usually involves scattered files and messages passed between the school, students, teachers, and the printing company. Anda brings this together on one platform, speeding up the process and giving students permanent access to their yearbooks.

Teacher contribution panel
Centralized data access for printing companies
School-based management

apps.name: Piridian
apps.subtitle: Gündüz Medya's global brand for digital products sold on international marketplaces.
apps.description: Piridian is the global digital product brand behind Gündüz Medya's international offerings, selling templates, trackers, and design files on marketplaces like Etsy and ThemeForest.
apps.longDescription: The name Piridian combines Piri Reis with 'meridian,' reflecting the brand's nautical, explorer-themed identity. Positioned separately from Gündüz Medya's Turkey-facing identity, Piridian is a dedicated digital product brand for international markets. It sells spreadsheet, PDF, and document-based digital products on Etsy - including a Job Application Tracker, Nautical Flag Alphabet Print Set, Beaufort Wind Scale Print Set, Minimalist Undated Habit Tracker, Freelance Invoice Tracker, and Developer Resume Template - and can serve as the umbrella brand for other globally launched projects.
